title: Murmuring Moonlight Mollusk
statement: A pearl-shelled nautilus the size of a teacup, she hums in soft bubbles as she drifts through a tank of deep indigo water, trailing a faint glow like a lantern someone forgot to put out. She spends her evenings circling a small drowned library of mossy stones and swaying kelp, pausing at each spine-like fern as if reading it, and the tank brightens a little whenever she finds a page she likes.
